headline: Stop-slip model refit keeps the bad tails (live stops fill +0.059R past the stop on average, p99 0.38R) and goes into the replay before tonight's fresh, unaided rule-21 audit.
bullets: Refit: slip = -0.003 + 0.63 x spread/stop; slope 0.74 on sell-off days vs 0.34 on calm days, so a fixed fit misprices by ~0.02R.
If needed, one day-speed term known at the time (e.g. SPY's first-hour range) - not a refit per window.
Per-setup correlation (ICC) differs by setup group: structure setups ~0.10, flow/gap-day ~0.18, heat/momentum ~0.39; pending a check that the groups were fixed in advance.
After the 11-12 close: fresh FWDCAL audit, NEWSMID one look, FAMC session 2.
Open owner items: COMPCAL, PROMO2, RULE21-DB, the days 1-3 questions, S6.
next: Stop-slip plug-in; after 16:00: fresh audit, NEWSMID, FAMC session 2; evening PR.
